voice.summary: Peakflow writes with the economy of a business card: a few words, a friendly nod, an open door. It is polite, short and happy to be reached.
dos: Use the fewest words that stay friendly
Say who will reply and when
Give one way to get in touch
donts: Do not ask for unneeded details
Do not hide the contact method

boilerplate: Peakflow is a small company that invites people to get in touch or join its community through a simple contact page.

microcopy.error: We could not send that. Please try again.

logo.note: A peak is a calm, simple mark for a minimal brand.
